page.overview:
Who is Achillobator?

(meaning "Achilles hero") is an extinct genus of dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived in Asia (specifically Mongolia) during the Late Cretaceous period around 96-89 million years ago. It is named after the Greek mythological hero Achilles, who has been known as the greatest of all the Greek warriors.

Achillobator was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.

Achillobator was released a part of the Jurassic World: Rebirth toyline as a Strike Attack figure.

Achillobator is one of the many raptor species that were mentioned on a plaque display.
